decisions.reason: As a close-to-core Magento shop template it is inexpensive to leave available and its value is still uncertain, so the option is worth keeping open despite limited prominence on the website.
A responsive website template fits the firm’s customer base and can likely be maintained at low cost, so management would keep it while demand information continues to emerge.
Premium customer support is highly aligned with the firm’s service-led positioning and uses existing capabilities, making abandonment unlikely.
The software version management tool builds directly on the firm’s technical platform and own R&D, and its dedicated page suggests enough commitment to continue learning from the market.

The data processing contract tool is relatively distant from the hosting core and likely needs ongoing legal and product upkeep, so a medium-sized firm with many other options would be inclined to cut it if it has not clearly proven its value.
